title: British Beauty Council’s new Impact of Beauty report outlines social and cultural value of UK beauty
summary: The British Beauty Council’s Impact of Beauty report, produced with Oxford Economics and supported by L’Oréal, reveals how beauty is not a trivial luxury but the ‘beating heart’ of the UK high streets. Council CEO Millie Kendall explains why beauty and wellbeing are so intrinsically linked for Brits in this opinion piece
